Film je napravljen za 80. rođendan patrijarha Kirila, poglavara Ruske pravoslavne crkve.
The film was made for the 80th birthday of Patriarch Kirill, the head of the Russian Orthodox Church.
Putin je govorio o Ukrajini i rekao da ukrajinski vojnici trebaju preći na rusku stranu.
Putin spoke about Ukraine and said that Ukrainian soldiers should cross over to the Russian side.
Tvrdio je da Ukrajina danas ima oko 20 miliona stanovnika, a 1986. godine imala je više od 50 miliona.
He claimed that Ukraine today has about 20 million inhabitants, while in 1986 it had more than 50 million.
Ispričao je i da ga je majka tajno krstila, a da otac nije znao.
He also said that his mother had him baptised in secret, without his father knowing.
Kasnije je saznao da je otac patrijarha Kirila bio svećenik u toj crkvi.
Later he found out that Patriarch Kirill's father was a priest in that church.
Na pitanje da li je Rusija barka koja spašava vjernike, Putin je odgovorio da jeste.
Asked whether Russia is an ark that saves believers, Putin answered that it is.
Rekao je da je Moskva treći Rim i da četvrtog neće biti.
He said that Moscow is the third Rome and that there will be no fourth.
Prema njegovim riječima, u Rusiji postoje četiri tradicionalne religije: pravoslavlje, islam, judaizam i budizam.
According to him, there are four traditional religions in Russia: Orthodoxy, Islam, Judaism and Buddhism.
Cijeli intervju objavljen je na web-stranici Kremlja.
The whole interview was published on the Kremlin website.

title: Financial Times: Poslovi Trumpovih ljudi prijete miru u BiH
Financial Times: Business deals of Trump's people threaten peace in BiH
body: Britanski list Financial Times objavio je tekst o novoj politici SAD-a prema Bosni i Hercegovini.
The British newspaper Financial Times has published an article about the new US policy towards Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Prema listu, Washington sada više brine o poslovima ljudi bliskih Donaldu Trumpu nego o miru i stabilnosti.
According to the paper, Washington now cares more about the business of people close to Donald Trump than about peace and stability.
SAD su prije 30 godina Dejtonskim sporazumom zaustavile rat u BiH i dugo su branile taj sistem.
Thirty years ago the US stopped the war in BiH with the Dayton Agreement, and it defended that system for a long time.
U centru priče je kompanija AAFS, koju vode bivši Trumpov advokat Jesse Binnall i Joseph Flynn.
At the centre of the story is the company AAFS, which is run by Trump's former lawyer Jesse Binnall and Joseph Flynn.
Bijela kuća podržava AAFS kao investitora u Južnu interkonekciju, gasovod koji bi BiH povezao s Hrvatskom.
The White House supports AAFS as the investor in the Southern Interconnection, a gas pipeline that would connect BiH with Croatia.
Parlament FBiH je u aprilu promijenio zakon, pa je AAFS postao glavni investitor bez javnog tendera.
In April the FBiH Parliament changed the law, so AAFS became the main investor without a public tender.
Organizacija Transparency International rekla je da je to opasan presedan.
The organisation Transparency International said that this is a dangerous precedent.
Binnall tvrdi da im veze s Trumpom nisu otvorile vrata.
Binnall claims that their connections with Trump did not open doors for them.
List piše i da je visoki predstavnik Christian Schmidt najavio ostavku nakon jakog pritiska Trumpove administracije.
The paper also writes that High Representative Christian Schmidt announced his resignation after strong pressure from the Trump administration.
Bivši ambasador SAD-a u BiH Michael Murphy rekao je da Washington želi visokog predstavnika kojeg može kontrolisati.
The former US ambassador to BiH, Michael Murphy, said that Washington wants a high representative it can control.
Senatorica Jeanne Shaheen upozorila je da takva politika može dovesti do novog sukoba.
Senator Jeanne Shaheen warned that such a policy could lead to a new conflict.

title: Trump zatvorio oči dok je Xi govorio na samitu u Kini
Trump closed his eyes while Xi spoke at the summit in China
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump sjedio je oko 10 sekundi zatvorenih očiju na samitu APEC-a u Kini.
US President Donald Trump sat with his eyes closed for about 10 seconds at the APEC summit in China.
To se desilo u četvrtak u gradu Shenzhenu, dok je kineski predsjednik Xi Jinping držao govor.
This happened on Thursday in the city of Shenzhen, while Chinese President Xi Jinping was giving a speech.
Xi je govorio o slobodnoj trgovini i ekonomskoj saradnji u regiji.
Xi spoke about free trade and economic cooperation in the region.
Snimak je napravila kineska državna televizija CCTV, a brzo se proširio društvenim mrežama.
The footage was made by Chinese state television CCTV, and it quickly spread on social media.
Kritičari tvrde da je Trump zaspao i to nazivaju sramotom.
Critics claim that Trump fell asleep and call it a disgrace.
Slični snimci kruže od 2025. godine, i to sa sastanaka u Bijeloj kući.
Similar videos have been circulating since 2025, including from meetings in the White House.
Direktor za komunikacije Bijele kuće Steven Cheung rekao je da su to lažne vijesti.
The White House communications director Steven Cheung said that this is fake news.
Prema njegovim riječima, Trump je gledao papire ispred sebe.
According to him, Trump was looking at the papers in front of him.
Trump je u januaru rekao da samo trepće i da su mu sastanci opuštajući.
In January Trump said that he was only blinking and that he finds meetings relaxing.
Trump ima 80 godina i najstarija je osoba koja je postala predsjednik SAD-a.
Trump is 80 years old and is the oldest person to have become US president.

title: Maya Jama nagovijestila da želi biti nova Bondova djevojka
Maya Jama hints that she wants to be the new Bond girl
body: Britanska voditeljica Maya Jama objavila je na Instagramu fotografiju glumice Monice Bellucci.
British presenter Maya Jama posted a photo of actress Monica Bellucci on Instagram.
Nazvala ju je svojom muzom, a mnogi to vide kao znak da želi ulogu u novom filmu o Jamesu Bondu.
She called her her muse, and many see this as a sign that she wants a role in the new James Bond film.
Bellucci je 2015. godine glumila u Bond filmu "Spectre", uz Daniela Craiga.
In 2015 Bellucci acted in the Bond film "Spectre", alongside Daniel Craig.
Ovo je već druga objava za nekoliko dana koja podgrijava glasine.
This is already the second post in a few days that fuels the rumours.
Robert Pattinson je u ponedjeljak predstavljen kao novi James Bond.
On Monday Robert Pattinson was presented as the new James Bond.
Kladionica William Hill sada daje Jami bolje šanse za ulogu, 5 prema 1 umjesto 7 prema 1.
The bookmaker William Hill now gives Jama better odds for the role, 5 to 1 instead of 7 to 1.
Snimanje novog filma očekuje se tokom 2027. godine.
Filming of the new film is expected during 2027.
Jama je nedavno napustila emisiju "Love Island" nakon što je potpisala ugovor s Netflixom.
Jama recently left the show "Love Island" after she signed a contract with Netflix.
Kao kandidatkinje za ulogu spominju se i Sydney Sweeney, Kendall Jenner i Margaret Qualley.
Sydney Sweeney, Kendall Jenner and Margaret Qualley are also mentioned as candidates for the role.

title: Energetska pića mogu biti opasna za srce mladih ljudi
Energy drinks may be dangerous for young people's hearts
body: Nova analiza iz SAD-a pokazuje da energetska pića mogu biti opasnija za srce nego što se mislilo.
A new analysis from the US shows that energy drinks may be more dangerous for the heart than was thought.
Rezultati su predstavljeni ovog mjeseca na skupu Američkog udruženja za srce.
The results were presented this month at a meeting of the American Heart Association.
Istraživači su pregledali 28.345 prijava zdravstvenih problema iz perioda od 2017. do 2025. godine.
The researchers examined 28,345 reports of health problems from the period from 2017 to 2025.
Od toga, 854 prijave odnosile su se na proizvode s kofeinom ili drugim stimulansima.
Of these, 854 reports concerned products with caffeine or other stimulants.
Stimulansi su tvari koje ubrzavaju rad srca i tijela.
Stimulants are substances that speed up the work of the heart and the body.
Kod tih proizvoda srčani zastoj prijavljivan je oko 11 puta češće, a infarkt oko 4,5 puta češće.
With these products cardiac arrest was reported about 11 times more often, and heart attack about 4.5 times more often.
Oko 45 posto problema imale su mlade osobe od 18 do 34 godine.
About 45 percent of the problems were in young people aged 18 to 34.
Autori misle da mladi češće piju ova pića prije treninga ili ih miješaju s alkoholom.
The authors think that young people drink these drinks more often before training or mix them with alcohol.
Kardiolog Gregory Marcus rekao je da studija ne dokazuje direktnu vezu, ali da su potrebna nova istraživanja.
Cardiologist Gregory Marcus said that the study does not prove a direct link, but that new research is needed.
Za većinu zdravih odraslih osoba do 400 miligrama kofeina dnevno smatra se sigurnim.
For most healthy adults up to 400 milligrams of caffeine a day is considered safe.

title: Mirvić aktivirao mjenice od 500.000 KM, Željezničar se buni
Mirvić cashes in promissory notes worth 500,000 KM, Željezničar objects
body: Bivši investitor FK Željezničar Sanin Mirvić aktivirao je dvije mjenice vrijedne ukupno 500.000 KM.
Former FK Željezničar investor Sanin Mirvić has activated two promissory notes worth a total of 500,000 KM.
Mjenica je papir kojim se neko obavezuje da će platiti dug.
A promissory note is a paper by which someone promises to pay a debt.
Banka je klub o tome obavijestila 19. novembra, a klub kaže da njegov račun nije blokiran.
The bank informed the club about it on 19 November, and the club says that its account is not blocked.
Mirvić je u septembru tražio da mu klub vrati 923.181 KM.
In September Mirvić asked the club to return 923,181 KM to him.
Prema klubu, on je ove godine uplatio 524.000 KM, ali traži skoro 400.000 KM više.
According to the club, he paid 524,000 KM this year, but he is asking for almost 400,000 KM more.
Klub kaže da je taj novac išao drugim osobama i da o tim uplatama nije znao.
The club says that this money went to other people and that it did not know about those payments.
Sud je ranije zabranio naplatu mjenica, ali ta odluka više ne važi.
A court earlier banned collection on the notes, but that decision is no longer valid.
Predstavnici kluba sastali su se s Mirvićem 13. novembra.
Club representatives met with Mirvić on 13 November.
Ponudili su da mu vrate novac koji je uplatio na račun kluba, ali on je to odbio.
They offered to return the money he had paid into the club's account, but he refused.
Advokati bi trebali nastaviti razgovore početkom sljedeće sedmice.
The lawyers are expected to continue talks at the beginning of next week.
Mirvić je krajem juna podnio ostavku na mjesto predsjednika kluba.
At the end of June Mirvić resigned from the post of club president.

title: Vijeće ministara ukinulo odluku o kupovini zgrade u Istočnom Sarajevu
Council of Ministers cancels decision on buying a building in East Sarajevo
body: Vijeće ministara BiH ukinulo je svoju odluku o kupovini zgrade za državne institucije u Istočnom Sarajevu.
The Council of Ministers of BiH has cancelled its decision on buying a building for state institutions in East Sarajevo.
Nova odluka objavljena je danas u Službenom glasniku BiH.
The new decision was published today in the Official Gazette of BiH.
Vijeće ju je donijelo na sjednici 28. oktobra, a potpisala ju je predsjedavajuća Borjana Krišto.
The Council adopted it at a session on 28 October, and it was signed by the chair, Borjana Krišto.
Ipak, država nije odustala od kupovine zgrada.
However, the state has not given up on buying buildings.
Zgrade u Istočnom Sarajevu i Banjoj Luci sada će se kupiti kroz javnu nabavku.
The buildings in East Sarajevo and Banja Luka will now be bought through public procurement.
Javna nabavka je postupak u kojem država traži najbolju ponudu od više prodavača.
Public procurement is a procedure in which the state looks for the best offer from several sellers.
Rok za cijeli projekat pomjeren je do kraja 2027. godine.
The deadline for the whole project has been moved to the end of 2027.
Postupke će voditi Služba za zajedničke poslove institucija BiH.
The procedures will be run by the Joint Services of BiH Institutions.
Vijeće ministara je ovlastilo direktora te službe da potpiše ugovore o kupovini.
The Council of Ministers authorised the director of that service to sign the purchase contracts.
On će to moći uraditi kada postupci javne nabavke budu završeni.
He will be able to do that when the public procurement procedures are finished.

title: SDP podržao Nikšića nakon optužnice, traži istragu tužilaca
SDP backs Nikšić after indictment, asks for an investigation of prosecutors
body: Socijaldemokratska partija BiH dala je punu podršku svom predsjedniku Nerminu Nikšiću.
The Social Democratic Party of BiH has given full support to its president, Nermin Nikšić.
Tužilaštvo POSKOK danas je podiglo optužnicu protiv Nikšića, Rame Isaka, Vahidina Munjića i drugih.
The POSKOK prosecutor's office today filed an indictment against Nikšić, Ramo Isak, Vahidin Munjić and others.
Tužioci traže i da Nikšić i Isak ne mogu obavljati svoje funkcije.
The prosecutors also ask that Nikšić and Isak cannot perform their duties.
Nikšić je ranije danas rekao da nijedna riječ iz optužnice nije istinita.
Earlier today Nikšić said that not a single word of the indictment is true.
SDP kaže da podržava nezavisan rad pravosuđa, ali traži da sudija pažljivo pročita dokaze.
SDP says that it supports the independent work of the judiciary, but it asks the judge to read the evidence carefully.
Stranka je uvjerena da će optuženi dokazati da su nevini.
The party is convinced that the accused will prove that they are innocent.
Prema SDP-u, neki ljudi iz tužilaštva daju materijale medijima da bi utjecali na politiku.
According to SDP, some people from the prosecution give materials to the media in order to influence politics.
Zato SDP traži da VSTV istraži veze između tužilaca i medija.
That is why SDP asks the VSTV to investigate the links between prosecutors and the media.
VSTV je tijelo koje bira i kontroliše sudije i tužioce u BiH.
The VSTV is the body that appoints and supervises judges and prosecutors in BiH.
Stranka nije navela imena tužilaca ni medija i nije pokazala dokaze za svoje tvrdnje.
The party did not name the prosecutors or the media and did not show evidence for its claims.

title: BBC objavio reportažu o selu Lukomir na Bjelašnici
BBC publishes a report on the village of Lukomir on Bjelašnica
body: Britanski BBC objavio je putopis o Lukomiru, najvišem i najizoliranijem selu u Bosni i Hercegovini.
The British BBC has published a travel story about Lukomir, the highest and most isolated village in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Tekst je napisala američka novinarka Kristin Vuković, koja je u selo došla s prijateljima i vodičem.
The text was written by American journalist Kristin Vuković, who came to the village with friends and a guide.
Od Umoljana do Lukomira hodali su sedam kilometara, oko tri sata.
From Umoljani to Lukomir they walked seven kilometres, about three hours.
U selu ljudi žive od 1. maja do 1. novembra, a zimu provode u nižim mjestima, uglavnom u Hadžićima.
People live in the village from 1 May to 1 November, and they spend the winter in lower places, mostly in Hadžići.
Oni koji još imaju ovce vode ih pješice, a put traje oko 10 sati.
Those who still have sheep take them on foot, and the journey takes about 10 hours.
Struja je u selo stigla tek prije oko 60 godina i često nestaje.
Electricity arrived in the village only about 60 years ago, and it often goes out.
U Lukomiru danas živi 55 ljudi u 25 domaćinstava, a svake godine dođe 100.000 do 150.000 turista.
Today 55 people live in Lukomir in 25 households, and 100,000 to 150,000 tourists come every year.
Novinarka je spavala kod Saime i Omera Čomora, gdje noćenje košta 30 eura.
The journalist stayed with Saima and Omer Čomor, where a night costs 30 euros.
Saima ju je naučila praviti pitu sa sirom u peći na drva.
Saima taught her to make cheese pie in a wood-fired oven.
Saima je rekla da su turisti iz Amerike, Australije i Evrope za selo velika Božija milost.
Saima said that the tourists from America, Australia and Europe are a great blessing from God for the village.

title: Menadžment Dine Merlina odgovorio Splitu i najavio pravnike
Dino Merlin's management responds to Split and announces lawyers
body: Menadžment Dine Merlina oglasio se nakon što je Split otkazao njegov novogodišnji koncert.
Dino Merlin's management has spoken out after Split cancelled his New Year concert.
Merlin je trebao pjevati 30. decembra na splitskoj Rivi.
Merlin was supposed to sing on 30 December on Split's Riva.
Gradonačelnik Tomislav Šuta ranije je objavio da koncerta neće biti.
Mayor Tomislav Šuta announced earlier that there would be no concert.
Prema menadžmentu, dogovorena cijena bila je 140.000 eura bruto za pjevača, cijeli tim i promociju.
According to the management, the agreed price was 140,000 euros gross for the singer, the whole team and promotion.
Sponzori bi platili 80.000 eura, pa bi trošak za gradski budžet bio mnogo manji.
Sponsors would have paid 80,000 euros, so the cost for the city budget would have been much smaller.
Iznos od 160.000 eura, o kojem pišu mediji, odnosi se na tehniku za dva koncerta, a ne na Merlinov honorar.
The amount of 160,000 euros that the media write about refers to the technology for two concerts, not to Merlin's fee.
Menadžment kaže i da ugovor nikada nije bio potpisan.
The management also says that the contract was never signed.
Oni pitaju zašto je grad otkazao samo njegov nastup, dok ostali program ide dalje.
They ask why the city cancelled only his performance, while the rest of the programme goes ahead.
Menadžment tvrdi da je pjevač zbog ove odluke pretrpio veliku štetu za ugled.
The management claims that the singer suffered great damage to his reputation because of this decision.
Zato će dalju komunikaciju s gradom voditi međunarodni tim pravnih stručnjaka.
That is why further communication with the city will be handled by an international team of legal experts.

title: Barbarez nakon žrijeba: Protiv Danske idemo hrabro
Barbarez after the draw: We go boldly against Denmark
body: Selektor BiH Sergej Barbarez govorio je nakon žrijeba za baraž Lige nacija u Nyonu.
Bosnia and Herzegovina head coach Sergej Barbarez spoke after the draw for the Nations League play-off in Nyon.
Zmajevi će u martu igrati protiv Danske za mjesto u Ligi A.
In March the Dragons will play Denmark for a place in League A.
Barbarez je rekao da se njegovo mišljenje nije promijenilo nakon žrijeba.
Barbarez said that his opinion did not change after the draw.
BiH je u svojoj grupi Lige B završila na drugom mjestu i zato igra baraž.
Bosnia and Herzegovina finished second in its League B group, and that is why it plays the play-off.
Danska je u grupi Lige A bila treća i sada se bori da ostane u najjačoj ligi.
Denmark was third in its League A group and is now fighting to stay in the strongest league.
Prema danskim medijima, prva utakmica bit će u BiH između 25. i 27. marta.
According to Danish media, the first match will be in Bosnia and Herzegovina between 25 and 27 March.
Revanš se igra u Danskoj između 28. i 30. marta 2027. godine.
The return leg is played in Denmark between 28 and 30 March 2027.
Barbarez je rekao da tim ide u baraž sa samopouzdanjem i dobrim rezultatima.
Barbarez said that the team goes into the play-off with confidence and good results.
Dodao je da je privilegija igrati protiv najboljih reprezentacija.
He added that it is a privilege to play against the best national teams.
Tačni datumi i stadioni još nisu potvrđeni, ali se očekuju Bilino Polje i Parken.
The exact dates and stadiums have not yet been confirmed, but Bilino Polje and Parken are expected.

title: Dodik ismijao pravilo UIO-a o povratu PDV-a za kuće
Dodik mocks the ITA rule on VAT refunds for houses
body: Lider SNSD-a Milorad Dodik ismijao je stav Uprave za indirektno oporezivanje BiH.
SNSD leader Milorad Dodik mocked the position of the Indirect Taxation Authority of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Uprava, ili UIO, kaže da građani koji grade kuću na svom zemljištu nemaju pravo na povrat PDV-a.
The authority, or UIO, says that citizens who build a house on their own land have no right to a VAT refund.
Dodik je na mreži X napisao da je to jedna od najglupljih stvari koje je nedavno čuo.
Dodik wrote on the X network that it is one of the most foolish things he has heard recently.
U video obraćanju je pitao na čijem placu ljudi trebaju graditi, možda u vasioni.
In a video address he asked on whose plot people should build, maybe in outer space.
Direktor UIO-a Zoran Tegeltija je član SNSD-a, a na to mjesto ga je postavio Dodik.
UIO director Zoran Tegeltija is a member of SNSD, and Dodik appointed him to that post.
U Upravnom odboru UIO-a je i ministar finansija Srđan Amidžić, koji je također kadar SNSD-a.
Finance minister Srđan Amidžić, who is also an SNSD official, is on the UIO management board too.
UIO je ranije objasnio da zakon priznaje samo kupovinu gotove kuće ili stana.
The UIO explained earlier that the law only recognises the purchase of a finished house or flat.
Ako zemljište ostaje vlasništvo građanina, firma može naplatiti samo usluge gradnje.
If the land remains the citizen's property, the company can only charge for construction services.
Za povrat PDV-a bi zemljište prije prodaje trebalo preći u vlasništvo firme koja gradi kuću.
For a VAT refund, the land would have to become the property of the company building the house before the sale.

title: Danska gradi novu ekipu nakon propuštenog Svjetskog prvenstva
Denmark is building a new team after missing the World Cup
body: Danska, protivnik BiH u baražu Lige nacija, pravi novu ekipu nakon velikog neuspjeha.
Denmark, Bosnia and Herzegovina's opponent in the Nations League play-off, is building a new team after a big failure.
Danci se nisu plasirali na Svjetsko prvenstvo, iako su deset godina igrali na svim velikim turnirima.
The Danes did not qualify for the World Cup, although they had played at every major tournament for ten years.
U finalu baraža u Pragu igrali su 2:2 s Češkom, a izgubili su nakon penala.
In the play-off final in Prague they drew 2:2 with Czechia, and lost after penalties.
Savez je ipak zadržao selektora Briana Riemera, čiji ugovor traje do Eura 2028.
The federation still kept head coach Brian Riemer, whose contract runs until Euro 2028.
Nekoliko važnih igrača je otišlo, među njima Simon Kjær i golman Kasper Schmeichel.
Several important players have left, among them Simon Kjær and goalkeeper Kasper Schmeichel.
Christian Eriksen nije igrao od juna, ali Riemer kaže da vrata za njega nisu zatvorena.
Christian Eriksen has not played since June, but Riemer says the door is not closed for him.
U Ligi nacija Danska je pobijedila Portugal u Bragi 4:1, ali je dva puta izgubila od Norveške.
In the Nations League Denmark beat Portugal 4:1 in Braga, but lost twice to Norway.
Riemer želi napadački nogomet, a u svojih prvih 20 utakmica tim je dao 44 gola.
Riemer wants attacking football, and in his first 20 matches the team scored 44 goals.
Slaba tačka je odbrana, jer selektor često igra rizično.
The weak point is the defence, because the coach often plays with risk.
Danska televizija TV 2 je objavila da je Danska dobila najbolji mogući žrijeb.
Danish broadcaster TV 2 reported that Denmark got the best possible draw.
Prva utakmica igra se u Zenici, a revanš u Danskoj.
The first match is played in Zenica, and the return leg in Denmark.

title: Sjećanje na 2003: Noć kada je Koševo plakalo
Remembering 2003: The night Koševo cried
body: BiH i Danska su se 2003. godine već sastale u utakmici koja je bila kao baraž.
Bosnia and Herzegovina and Denmark already met in 2003 in a match that was like a play-off.
Bilo je to 11. oktobra, u posljednjem kolu kvalifikacija za Euro 2004. u Portugalu.
It was on 11 October, in the last round of qualifiers for Euro 2004 in Portugal.
Pobjeda na Koševu bi BiH direktno odvela na Evropsko prvenstvo.
A win at Koševo would have taken Bosnia and Herzegovina directly to the European Championship.
Stadion je bio pun, a prodano je 40.000 ulaznica.
The stadium was full, and 40,000 tickets were sold.
Danska je povela u 12. minuti, kada je Martin Jørgensen pogodio pored golmana Kenana Hasagića.
Denmark took the lead in the 12th minute, when Martin Jørgensen scored past goalkeeper Kenan Hasagić.
U 39. minuti Hasan Salihamidžić je centrirao, a Elvir Bolić je glavom izjednačio na 1:1.
In the 39th minute Hasan Salihamidžić crossed, and Elvir Bolić equalised with a header to make it 1:1.
BiH nije uspjela dati drugi gol, iako je Danac Thomas Gravesen pred kraj dobio crveni karton.
Bosnia and Herzegovina did not manage to score a second goal, although the Dane Thomas Gravesen got a red card near the end.
Danska je tako direktno otišla na Euro, a BiH je u grupi završila četvrta.
Denmark thus went directly to the Euro, and Bosnia and Herzegovina finished fourth in the group.
Navijači su nakon utakmice napustili stadion u suzama.
After the match the fans left the stadium in tears.
Sada se ekipe ponovo sastaju, u martu u baražu Lige nacija.
Now the teams meet again, in March in the Nations League play-off.

title: Liga nacija: Hrvatska igra s Irskom, Španija s Francuskom
Nations League: Croatia plays Ireland, Spain plays France
body: UEFA je danas u Nyonu izvukla sve parove baraža i četvrtfinala Lige nacija.
UEFA today drew all the play-off and quarter-final pairs of the Nations League in Nyon.
Utakmice se igraju u martu 2027. godine, a svaki par igra dvije utakmice.
The matches are played in March 2027, and each pair plays two matches.
Najveći derbi je meč između Španije i Francuske.
The biggest clash is the match between Spain and France.
U baražu za Ligu A BiH igra s Danskom, a Mađarska sa Srbijom.
In the play-off for League A, Bosnia and Herzegovina plays Denmark, and Hungary plays Serbia.
Hrvatska igra protiv Irske, a Slovenija protiv Velsa.
Croatia plays against Ireland, and Slovenia against Wales.
U baražu za Ligu B Sjeverna Makedonija igra s Kiprom, a Rumunija s Estonijom.
In the play-off for League B, North Macedonia plays Cyprus, and Romania plays Estonia.
U četvrtfinalu Norveška igra s Engleskom, Holandija s Portugalom, a Belgija s Njemačkom.
In the quarter-finals Norway plays England, the Netherlands play Portugal, and Belgium plays Germany.
Pobjednik para Španija – Francuska igrat će u polufinalu protiv Norveške ili Engleske.
The winner of the Spain – France pair will play in the semi-final against Norway or England.
Prve utakmice su od 25. do 27. marta, a revanši od 28. do 30. marta.
The first matches are from 25 to 27 March, and the return legs from 28 to 30 March.
Prema pravilima UEFA-e, tim iz jače lige igra revanš na svom stadionu.
According to UEFA rules, the team from the stronger league plays the return leg at its own stadium.

title: BiH u baražu Lige nacija igra protiv Danske
Bosnia and Herzegovina will play Denmark in the Nations League play-off
body: Nogometna reprezentacija BiH igrat će protiv Danske u baražu za mjesto u Ligi A.
The Bosnia and Herzegovina football team will play Denmark in the play-off for a place in League A.
Žrijeb je danas održan u švicarskom gradu Nyonu, gdje se nalazi sjedište UEFA-e.
The draw was held today in the Swiss town of Nyon, where UEFA has its headquarters.
Utakmice se igraju krajem marta 2027. godine.
The matches will be played at the end of March 2027.
Prva utakmica bit će 25. ili 27. marta, a revanš 28. ili 30. marta.
The first match will be on 25 or 27 March, and the return leg on 28 or 30 March.
Pobjednik će u narednom izdanju igrati u Ligi A, a poraženi tim ide u Ligu B.
The winner will play in League A in the next edition, and the losing team goes to League B.
Danska je u svojoj grupi Lige A bila treća, dok je BiH u grupi Lige B završila druga.
Denmark finished third in its League A group, while Bosnia and Herzegovina finished second in its League B group.
Revanš uvijek igra kod kuće tim iz Lige A, zato Zmajevi prvi meč igraju kod kuće.
The League A team always plays the return leg at home, so the Dragons play the first match at home.
Ovo će biti peti i šesti službeni meč između ove dvije reprezentacije.
These will be the fifth and sixth official matches between these two national teams.
U kvalifikacijama za Svjetsko prvenstvo 1998. obje ekipe su slavile na svom terenu.
In the qualifiers for the 1998 World Cup, both teams won at home.
BiH je 2003. godine pobijedila u Kopenhagenu 2:0, ali je na Koševu igrala samo 1:1.
In 2003 Bosnia and Herzegovina won 2:0 in Copenhagen, but only drew 1:1 at Koševo.
UEFA je zabranila dolazak navijača BiH na prvu gostujuću utakmicu, pa u Danskoj neće biti domaćih navijača.
UEFA has banned Bosnian fans from the first away match, so there will be no Bosnian fans in Denmark.

title: Split otkazao novogodišnji koncert Dine Merlina
Split cancels Dino Merlin's New Year concert
body: Koncert Dine Merlina, koji je bio planiran za 30. decembar na splitskoj Rivi, neće se održati.
Dino Merlin's concert, which was planned for 30 December on Split's Riva, will not take place.
Odluku je na pres-konferenciji objavio gradonačelnik Splita Tomislav Šuta.
Split mayor Tomislav Šuta announced the decision at a press conference.
Koncert je bio dio adventskog programa u gradu.
The concert was part of the city's Advent programme.
Šuta je rekao da lično nije potpisao ugovor jer je situacija otišla u pogrešnom smjeru.
Šuta said that he personally did not sign the contract because the situation had gone in the wrong direction.
Više od 20.000 građana potpisalo je peticiju protiv koncerta.
More than 20,000 citizens signed a petition against the concert.
Oni su tražili da grad novac da za novi medicinski aparat za bolnicu u Splitu.
They asked the city to give the money for a new medical device for the hospital in Split.
Grad je dan ranije objavio da bi Merlin dobio 140.000 eura, a produkcija bi koštala 160.000 eura.
A day earlier the city announced that Merlin would get 140,000 euros, and the production would cost 160,000 euros.
Gradonačelnik sada kaže da je to bila samo procjena, jer javna nabavka nije bila završena.
The mayor now says that this was only an estimate, because the public procurement was not finished.
Rekao je i da mu je žao ljudi koji su već rezervisali smještaj u Splitu.
He also said that he feels sorry for the people who had already booked accommodation in Split.
Dino Merlin i njegov menadžment još nisu komentarisali odluku.
Dino Merlin and his management have not yet commented on the decision.

title: Teleskop Euclid snimio više od milijardu objekata u svemiru
The Euclid telescope has recorded more than a billion objects in space
body: Evropska svemirska agencija ESA objavila je prve velike podatke teleskopa Euclid.
The European Space Agency ESA has published the first large data set from the Euclid telescope.
Teleskop je za 13 mjeseci snimio više od milijardu objekata u svemiru.
In 13 months the telescope recorded more than a billion objects in space.
Euclid je lansiran u julu 2023. godine, a podaci pokrivaju dio neba velik kao 9.500 punih mjeseci.
Euclid was launched in July 2023, and the data covers a part of the sky as big as 9,500 full moons.
Među objektima je više od 900 miliona galaksija i više od 60 miliona mogućih kvazara.
Among the objects are more than 900 million galaxies and more than 60 million possible quasars.
Kvazari su vrlo svijetli centri dalekih galaksija.
Quasars are very bright centres of distant galaxies.
Teleskop je pronašao i oko 15.000 gravitacijskih leća, kada bliža galaksija savija svjetlost dalje galaksije.
The telescope also found about 15,000 gravitational lenses, when a nearer galaxy bends the light of a more distant galaxy.
Pomogli su kompjuterski programi i hiljade volontera.
Computer programs and thousands of volunteers helped.
Ovi podaci su osnova za najveću 3D mapu svemira, koja će pomoći u proučavanju tamne materije i tamne energije.
This data is the basis for the largest 3D map of the universe, which will help in studying dark matter and dark energy.
Naučnica Natalie Lines rekla je da se sada može izmjeriti masa pojedinih galaksija.
Scientist Natalie Lines said that the mass of individual galaxies can now be measured.
Do sada je snimljeno oko 14 posto neba, a novi podaci očekuju se sredinom 2027. godine.
So far about 14 percent of the sky has been recorded, and new data is expected in mid-2027.
